experiment: Compact full-resolution student with bottleneck spatial self-attention
optimizer: AdamW, weight decay .0001; learning-rate schedule recorded in each result
loss: RGB L1 + .25*(horizontal gradient L1 + vertical gradient L1)

architecture.type: four-level hierarchical residual CNN with global context gate
architecture.input_receptive_field_pixels: whole image via global context gate
architecture.internal_downsampling: learned features only; original pixels retained through input rearrangement and residual path

limitations: One scene and first-reset frames only; a spatial or camera holdout is not cross-scene generalization.
No temporal training or quality validation.
Torch timing excludes D3D12 integration and is not a hidden-demo benchmark.

output_grading.scope: Unfitted algebraic approximation from the same runtime controls; other camera views reuse the parameters by inference.
output_grading.training: Differentiable FP32 operations after the clamped learned residual.
output_grading.inference: FP16 network, FP32 grading, FP16 final storage; all included in graph timing.

architecture.type: four-level hierarchical residual CNN with global context gate and spatial self-attention
architecture.input_receptive_field_pixels: whole image via global context gate
architecture.internal_downsampling: learned features only; original pixels retained through input rearrangement and residual path

global_attention.position_encoding: none; attention receives the existing spatial CNN features
global_attention.timing_scope: included in complete network and output-grading graph

limitations: One scene and first-reset frames only; a spatial or camera holdout is not cross-scene generalization.
No temporal training or quality validation.
Torch timing excludes D3D12 integration and is not a hidden-demo benchmark.

output_grading.scope: Unfitted algebraic approximation from the same runtime controls; other camera views reuse the parameters by inference.
output_grading.training: Differentiable FP32 operations after the clamped learned residual.
output_grading.inference: FP16 network, FP32 grading, FP16 final storage; all included in graph timing.

implementation_checks.scope: Implementation and training-mechanics checks; no native-quality or app-latency claim.

branch_ablation.timing_scope: FP16 full-1080p network plus fused output grade; excludes application integration.
limitations: Disabling the branch is an ablation, not a separately retrained model.
Repeatedly consulted validation views from one scene; not an independent final test.
First-reset images only; no temporal or perceptual acceptance established.

original.limitation: One first-reset camera view. FFT bands describe error scale, not perceptual or temporal quality. Image borders are periodic in this diagnostic.

north.limitation: One first-reset camera view. FFT bands describe error scale, not perceptual or temporal quality. Image borders are periodic in this diagnostic.

shifted-north.limitation: One first-reset camera view. FFT bands describe error scale, not perceptual or temporal quality. Image borders are periodic in this diagnostic.

conclusions: The candidate improves training-view MAE but increases MAE on both held-out views.
RMSE and gradient metrics are mixed; no consistent quality improvement is established.
Disabling only the trained attention branch worsens the original training view while improving both validation MAEs, consistent with overfitting.
The complete network plus grade is approximately 1.3 ms in Torch; the native application remains approximately 5.4 ms.
The same two validation views have informed multiple experiments; they are not independent final acceptance data.
No temporal/cross-scene quality gate or application benchmark was performed; no replacement is accepted.
